about: Muse Glimmer 30B EXL3 SC 4.00 bpw H5 with Meta's assistant drafter (DFlash, 4.00 bpw EXL3) for speculative decoding on TabbyAPI, 256K window on one 24 GB card

config.text:
network:
  host: 0.0.0.0
  port: 5000
  disable_auth: true
  disable_fetch_requests: true
  send_tracebacks: false
  api_servers: ["OAI"]
  sse_ping_interval: 15

logging:
  log_prompt: false
  log_generation_params: false
  log_requests: false
  log_chat_completion_requests: false

model:
  model_dir: /workspace/models
  inline_model_loading: false
  use_dummy_models: false
  model_name: Muse-Glimmer-30B-EXL3-SC4.00bpw-H5
  backend: exllamav3
  max_seq_len: 262144
  cache_size: 263168
  cache_mode: FP16
  tensor_parallel: false
  gpu_split_auto: true
  autosplit_reserve: [512]
  chunk_size: 2048
  output_chunking: true
  max_batch_size: 1
  vision: true
  vision_offload: true
  tool_format: muse_glimmer

draft_model:
  draft_mode: model
  draft_model_dir: /workspace/draft
  draft_model_name: Muse-Glimmer-30B-assistant-EXL3-4.00bpw
  draft_cache_mode: Q8
  draft_num_tokens: 5

sampling:
  override_preset:

memory:
  sysmem_recurrent_cache: 4096
  sysmem_kv_cache: 0
  cuda_malloc_async: true
